meta.title: Custom awarding rule typed into the Smart Awarding chat

args.goal: in the open Smart Awarding side panel, type a custom awarding rule into the chat text box, click the blue send icon, and stop when an AI response showing a suggested awarding plan with vendor suggestions and justification is visible

steps.note: Performs and observes the chat interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirms the resulting screen has no crash or server error after processing the request.
